import copy,hashlib,importlib.metadata as md,json,math,platform,socket,sys,time
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
started=time.monotonic()
network_attempts=[]
def denied_connect(*args,**kwargs):
    network_attempts.append("socket.connect")
    raise RuntimeError("Offline score reproduction cannot connect to a network.")
socket.socket.connect=denied_connect
from legal_skill_guard.openexempt import ROOT,UPSTREAM,evaluate
root=Path.cwd()
assert ROOT.resolve()==root.resolve()
record_path=Path("runs/legal_openexempt_v6_frozen_source_isolated_IID128_20261031_run01/scored_records.json")
table_path=Path("paper/tables/utility_frozen_results_20261101.json")
cfg_path=Path("artifacts/launches/openexempt_v6_final_after_withheld_20261031_run01/actual_final_matrix_config.json")
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
before={str(p):sha(p) for p in [record_path,table_path,cfg_path]}
assert before[str(record_path)]=="ff72aa2ba7c27d1d2725c938729a278c4a68e28068871d5da09aa827ddaa9cf6"
assert before[str(table_path)]=="3879cee0d1f5765f3a00637b2c3252640c570d2eed7da4cc1f05031ecd4fb732"
records=json.loads(record_path.read_text())
cfg=json.loads(cfg_path.read_text())
packet_path=Path(cfg["input_packet"])
rows=json.loads(packet_path.read_text())["rows"]
lookup={(x["case_id"],x["family"]):x for x in rows}
assert len(lookup)==256
assert {x["family"] for x in rows}=={"EC","EV"}
assert sha(packet_path)==cfg["input_packet_sha256"]
gold_paths={x["case_id"]:Path(cfg["grading_directory"])/(str(x["case_id"])+".json") for x in rows}
gold={i:json.loads(p.read_text()) for i,p in gold_paths.items()}
gold_hashes={str(p):sha(p) for p in gold_paths.values()}
table={x["condition"]:x for x in json.loads(table_path.read_text())["conditions"]}
score_mismatches=[];metric_mismatches=[];summary=[];checked=0;parse_invalid=0
for arm,items in records.items():
    assert len(items)==256
    assert {(r["case_id"],r["family"]) for r in items}==set(lookup)
    fresh={"EC":[],"EV":[]}
    for r in items:
        row=lookup[r["case_id"],r["family"]]
        assert r["source_key"]==row["source_key"]==gold[r["case_id"]]["source_key"]
        answer=r["parsed"]["answer"] if r["parse_error"] is None else None
        parse_invalid+=int(r["parse_error"] is not None)
        score=evaluate(row,answer,copy.deepcopy(gold[r["case_id"]]["targets"][r["family"]]))
        if score!=r["score"]:
            keys=sorted(set(score)|set(r["score"]))
            score_mismatches.append({"arm":arm,"case_id":r["case_id"],"family":r["family"],"differences":{k:{"original":r["score"].get(k),"fresh":score.get(k)} for k in keys if score.get(k)!=r["score"].get(k)}})
        fresh[r["family"]].append(score);checked+=1
    result={"condition":arm,"families":{}}
    for family,scores in fresh.items():
        m={"tasks":len(scores),"invalid_format":sum(s["invalid_format"] for s in scores)}
        for field in ["precision","recall","f1","full_output_f1","exact_target"]:
            m[field]=sum(s[field] for s in scores)/len(scores)
        expected=table[arm]["metrics"][family]
        for k,v in m.items():
            if not math.isclose(v,expected[k],rel_tol=0,abs_tol=1e-12):
                metric_mismatches.append({"arm":arm,"family":family,"metric":k,"original":expected[k],"fresh":v})
        result["families"][family]=m
    summary.append(result)
after={p:sha(p) for p in before}
assert before==after
assert gold_hashes=={str(p):sha(p) for p in gold_paths.values()}
core=["numpy","inflect","rapidfuzz","pydantic","langchain-core","langsmith"]
locations={n:str(md.distribution(n).locate_file("").resolve()) for n in core}
isolated=all(Path(p).is_relative_to(Path(sys.prefix)) for p in locations.values())
assert sys.prefix!=sys.base_prefix and isolated
out={
 "at_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 "status":"passed" if not score_mismatches and not metric_mismatches else "mismatch",
 "scope":"Fresh isolated dependency environment, same immutable source tree and existing parsed predictions/targets: full original ten-condition offline score reproduction. Not full training or inference reproduction.",
 "python":{"version":platform.python_version(),"executable":sys.executable,"prefix":sys.prefix,"base_prefix":sys.base_prefix,"is_venv":sys.prefix!=sys.base_prefix,"core_distributions_all_from_new_venv":isolated},
 "core_versions":{n:md.version(n) for n in core},
 "core_distribution_locations":locations,
 "installed_distribution_versions":dict(sorted((d.metadata["Name"],d.version) for d in md.distributions())),
 "source_files_sha256":{**before,str(packet_path):sha(packet_path),"legal_skill_guard/openexempt.py":sha("legal_skill_guard/openexempt.py"),str(UPSTREAM.relative_to(root)/"evaluator.py"):sha(UPSTREAM/"evaluator.py")},
 "grading_files_count":len(gold_hashes),
 "grading_files_hash_map_sha256":hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(gold_hashes,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()).hexdigest(),
 "conditions":len(records),"sources":len(gold),"records_checked":checked,"original_parse_invalid_records_retained":parse_invalid,
 "exact_per_record_score_dictionary_mismatches":len(score_mismatches),"score_mismatch_examples":score_mismatches[:5],
 "aggregated_original_table_metric_mismatches":len(metric_mismatches),"metric_mismatch_examples":metric_mismatches[:5],
 "family_summaries":summary,
 "original_evidence_unchanged":before==after,
 "network_connect_guard_attempts":len(network_attempts),
 "new_model_teacher_or_prediction_calls":0,
 "elapsed_seconds_including_imports_and_scoring":time.monotonic()-started,
 "limitations":["The source tree and data are reused under their current hashes, not cloned on an independent machine.","Weights, serving runtime, teacher availability, training and fresh predictions were not exercised.","No paired confidence intervals or SkillCommit outcomes are newly recomputed by this check."]
}
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
